title: Retrieval Pivot Attacks in Hybrid RAG: Measuring and Mitigating Amplified Leakage from Vector Seeds to Graph Expansion
why_relevant: Introduces a new attack surface (retrieval pivot attacks) in hybrid vector+graph RAG, with metrics for leakage and defenses, fitting the adversarial corruption and security aspects of robust RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on cross-tenant data leakage/access control rather than core robustness to noisy/conflicting evidence; somewhat niche to hybrid GraphRAG.
